comment: Synthetic mutant for Issue 6 (message_decrypt_prekey skips pre_key_store.remove_pre_key): provisioned with a one-time pre-key (with_opk = true), Alice sends an OPK-bearing pre-key message and Bob receives it; on the mutant, one-time-pre-keys/<opk_id> remains non-empty on disk, so the environment leaks Bob's OPK before Bob's reply.
